Test: TC-3562 — Feature area - Box scope - Sub-scope definition - Creating sprints - Atlassian Cloud
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Automated
Folder: /BP/TS-19 Feature area - Box scope - Sub-scope definition
Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated, rocksolid

Steps:
1. Navigate to Box Configuration -> Tasks -> Scope definition tab of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3562 Feature area - Box scope - Sub-scope definition - Creating sprints - Atlassian Cloud
   Expected: Scope definition tab is displayed.
In the Timeboxes section Connected Jira Field of sub-box PI1 has 'Program Increment' value.
2. Click 'Level down' button of boxName
   Data: boxName: PI1
   Expected: One iteration box is visible: Iteration1. Connected Jira Field is set to Sprint. Value column has placeholder 'Select or create Jira Sprint'. 
There is a checkbox which states 'Each team has a different mapping with value.
3. Click the checkbox to mark Each team has a different mapping with value for Iteration1.
   Expected: Each team has a different mapping with value is ticked. User sees two rows with Team Name and Value in Iteration sub-box:
- Team unassigned
- Zespol 1

All funnel icons are black and have an orange dot beside them, since on Atlassian Cloud a Board must be selected by default.
All selectors of Value have placeholder 'Select or create Jira Sprint'.
4. Click 'Select or create Jira Sprint' selector of teamName.
   Data: teamName: Zespol 1
   Expected: Search field wrapper appeared.
5. Click the space bar twice.
   Expected: "No matches" is displayed. The user is unable to create a Sprint.
6. Click funnel icon of teamName.
   Data: teamName: Zespol 1
   Expected: Search field wrapper appeared with boards list.
7. Type in boardName and select it.
   Data: boardName: TC3562 board
   Expected: Orange dot is still visible in right upper corner of filter button.
Filter icon is black and has a tooltip 'Filter value by TC3562 board'
Selector of Value has placeholder 'Select or create Jira Sprint'
8. Click 'Select or create Jira Sprint' selector of teamName.
   Data: teamName: Zespol 1
   Expected: Search field wrapper appears with sprints listed from TC3562 board. The folLowing options are visible:
- Lowest
- TC3562 Sprint 1
- TC3562 Sprint 2
- TC3562 Sprint 3
9. Type in a newSprintName.
   Data: newSprintName: This is over thirty characters Sprint name
   Expected: Tip message is visible: Create "This is over thirty characters" in TC3562 board. This is because of a Jira limitation that Sprints have to be less than or 30 characters.
10. Click on the tipMessage. Save the configuration.
   Data: tipMessage: Create "This is over thirty characters" in TC3562 board
   Expected: Search field wrapper disappears. The value is set to "This is over thirty characters"

Green message appears on screen:

Title: Sprint created
Content: Sprint was successfully created on the selected Jira board
11. In Jira click Projects -> View all projects
   Expected: All projects are visible.
12. Search and click on projectName and go to Backlog tab.
   Data: projectName: TC-3562 Feature area - Box scope - Sub-scope definition - Creating - JC
   Expected: Backlog screen is visible. User sees four sprints:

- TC3562 Sprint 1
- TC3562 Sprint 2
- TC3562 Sprint 3
